name: First Session Route
summary: Claim rewards, unlock map/watch/home basics, and avoid spending rare materials.
steps: Claim mailbox rewards and current codes
Follow main quest until map and watch are introduced
Set one money route before exploring everything
Save rare materials until upgrade needs are clear

name: Starter Crop Money
summary: Pick Tomato, Potato, Wheat, or Lettuce based on how long you will play.
steps: Use Tomato or Pineapple for short active sessions
Use Potato for one-hour loops
Use Wheat, Lettuce, or Corn before logging off
Compare crops before buying large seed stacks

name: Fishing Unlock & Rare Route
summary: Unlock fishing with Vanya, learn tension, then route by water type and weather.
steps: Meet Vanya through the early route
Finish the repair kit step
Practice white/yellow/red tension timing
Prioritize Rainbow weather and Level 10 targets later

name: Cooking ROI Route
summary: Turn crop and fish outputs into recipes, but avoid QTE losses on rare inputs.
steps: Unlock the Massimo cooking route
Start with jam or Fish and Chips
Use Recipe Finder before cooking random inventory
Avoid event or rare ingredients until value is known

name: Daily Friendship Loop
summary: Choose one NPC target, check route, gift once, and record completion.
steps: Pick one priority NPC instead of spreading gifts everywhere
Check location and schedule before walking
Use safe gift lanes first
Mark gift route done in the tracker

name: Pet & Animal Care Split
summary: Keep pet-shop pets, wild trough animals, farm animals, and Oak-Oak separate.
steps: Use Dog Food as the safe dog baseline
Do not mix Oak-Oak with normal dog care
Plan wild animal troughs from the map
Record food tests before spending cooked dishes

name: Event Prep Route
summary: Check active event windows, prep items, and avoid wasting limited materials.
steps: Open the event hub before starting routine routes
Check current and upcoming event status
Save prep tasks in the event detail panel
Do not cook or sell limited items before value is known

name: Home Layout Planning
summary: Plan room jobs, walking paths, materials, and shop handoffs before decorating.
steps: Pick a house design style and size
Check material requirements
Open shops for furniture and decor sources
Mark collected materials before building
